title_native: 3年Z組銀八先生
description:
Sakata Ginpachi is a high-school teacher with his trademark silver, curly hair, dead-fish eyes, and sloppily worn lab coat. He's in charge of Gintama High School's Class 3-Z: home to a ragtag group of frequent troublemakers including idol otaku, hurloines, stalkers, mayo guzzlers, sadists, delinquents, and many more.

If you thought this roller-coaster life would have Ginpachi holding his head in his hands, you thought wrong, as he nonchalantly resolves any trouble that comes his way. And if you thought this unique group of students would overcome adversity and come together as one, you thought wrong again, as they continue to raise hell!

"Oh, come on! Can 3-Z get any more ungovernable?!"

You can never tell what this atypical teacher is thinking and he never seems up for the task, but he always comes through when it counts. He and his students star in this school-life comedy full of laughs, tears, and the whole kitchen sink! Forget nerds, forget jocks, and come enjoy the kind of youthful days that only Gintama could ever deliver!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

One day, he receives a request from the chief of an island he knows. He is transferred to a remote island called Koumi-jima, also known as Childbirth Island.

The "favor" was...
The women of this island have evolved a unique constitution, with only one week between implantation and birth, due to the island's custom of specializing in the role of females, and have continued to thrive in their own unique way for hundreds of years. It seemed as if the island would continue to prosper at this rate, but because the islanders have been mixing only close genes among themselves, it has come to the point where only genes from outside the island can be used to produce the newborns.

The island chief's request was for Seiichi, an immensely fertile man with an outside gene: "I want you to impregnate all the girls on the island"
That's what it was!

The island's custom of specializing in the role of the female, the women want to satisfy the instincts of the men, who from the bottom of their hearts have the idea of male superiority. What will happen to the women who feel the supreme pleasure in pleasing men and giving birth to children when Seiichi appears on the scene??
